tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bla brang nyi lde na bzhugs pa'i rigs ldan chen po'i sku gdung gi lo rgyus kyi yi ge bzhugs// dharmā rā dza mahā bi dza ya kirti bhaṭṭa tsa shrī ka la tsakrā ye na maḥ 'dir smras pa/ byang phyogs shambha la'i rigs ldan chen po padma dkar po'i rnam par 'phrul pa'i bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo nyid gzhan ngor sa skyong mi dbang chen po'i tshul bzung ba'i skyes chen mchog tu/ dus mtshungs pa'i mkhas pa rnams mgrin gcig tu bsngags pa'i yul du gyur pa'i chos kyi rgyal po rnam rgyal grags pa bzang po 'di nyid ni/ skyes sbyangs kyi mkhyen rab phul du byung zhing / rigs kyi cod pan gyi tshogs kyang theg chen chos kyi rgyal po/ mus chen sems dpa' chen po/ bo dong paṇa chen/ chos rje rgyal ba dpal la sogs te mkhas grub kyi bla ma mang du bsten nas gsan nas gsan pa rgya mtsho'i pha mthar son cing / shes bya rig pa'i gnas lnga la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa brnyes pas 'chad rtsod kyi sgo nas kyang bstan pa dar bar mdzad cing / khyad par legs bshad kyi rtsom pa gsar du mdzad pa yang / mdo sngags rig gnas kyis bsdus pa'i gsung rab glegs bam gyi tshogs bcu grangs las brgal bar bzhugs pa rnams kyang / dpyod ldan gyi mkhas pa su zhig gis mthong ba'i tshe/ sprul pa'i sku'i gsung las gzhan du ma 'das pa'i yid ches kyi dad pa bskyed par nus pa sha stag tu 'byung la/ gzhan yang dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i blos bslangs kyi bkod pa ngo mtshar can gser dngul gar bu lugs su bzhengs par mdzad pa sogs lugs gnyis 'phrin las kyi rnam thar rmad du byung bas rgyal ba'i bstan pa spyi dang / bye brag rje btsun sa skya pa'i bstan pa bstan 'dzin dang bcas pa bla nas blar 'degs par mdzad de/ mthar dgung lo brgyad cu gya gcig tu son pa na pho brang chen po lhun grub steng nyid du snron gyi zla ba'i tshes drug la dag pa'i zhing du gshegs pa'i tshul bstan te/

sku gdung rin po che gnas der dngul gyi rnam rgyal mchod rten zhig bzhengs te bzhugs su gsol ba las/ dus phyis pho brang nyid nyams ches pa nas dngul gdung gi drung du mchod 'bul dang zhabs tog rgya chen po lta ci smos/ sku gdung nyid kyang srang dbar gyi khyi'i kha zas su 'gyur ba la ring po med par gyur pa na/ dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis/ rigs ldan chen po de nyid spyir sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin dang / yon bdag zung 'brel gyi gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇḍi ta chen po skyes bu mtshungs med yin pa dang / lhag par chos rgyal chen po 'di nas brgyud pa'i dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang rgyud man ngag gi chos tshul mtha' yas pa zhig thos pa'i brgyud pa'i bla ma bka' drin can yin pas rang rgyud la bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis rgya chen po thob pa'i slad du dkon mchog la lung bstan zhus pa bzang chug byung ba bzhin/ sku gdung rin po che lhun sdings nas spyan drangs te/ dpal sa skya'i bla brang nyi lder bzhugs su gsol ba'i tshe/ sngar arga'i cho ga bgyis pa'i dngul gdung bsgrig par brtsams te/ sku gdung rin po che la khrus gsol rgyas par phul nas mchod rten gyi bum par bzhugs su gsol ba na/ gdung gi sku dpung g.yas phyogs kyi ngos thams cad la drod tsha chil byung ba nye 'khor ba'i gang zag gnyis tsam gyis mngon sum du rig pa byung bas/ sngar pho brang lhun sdings su bzhugs skabs kyang dngul gdung gi bum ldir la bde drod rang 'bar du yod par rnam thar las kyang 'byung zhing / skyes bu rtog dpyod can rnams mgrin gcig tu gleng ba la yid ches lhag par skyes shing / mdor na rigs ldan chos kyi rgyal po'i gdung yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'di nyid la/ skal bzang dad ldan gyi skye bo su zhig gis gsol ba btab kyang mchog thun mong gi dngos grub bde blag tu stsol ba la yid gnyis dang bral bar shes par byas nas dpyod ldan dag gis mchod 'bul dang gsol 'debs la brtson par mdzad 'tshal lo/

/dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i bstan pa'i srol/ /gsal bar mdzad la byang phyogs shambha la'i/ /chos rgyal rigs ldan rnams dang dbyer med pa'i/ /skyes bu'i gtsug rgyan mi dbang paṇḍi ta/ /rnam rgyal grags bzang sku gdung rin po che/ /pho brang lhun sdings bzhugs pa dus dbang gis/ /'jig par nye tshe sngags 'chang sa skya pa/ /ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams zhes bya bas/ /bsam sbyor dag pa'i zhabs tog 'di bgyis pa'i/ /dge bas bdag cag dpon slob gdul byar bcas/ /tshe mthar phyin cing bsam don kun 'grub ste/ /phyi ma lhan cig bde ba can bgrod shog /ka lyā na wardhantu/dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig oṃ a ma ra ṇi dzī bantī ye swāhā/dpal ster 'chi ba med pa srog ldan mas gzhi tshugs/ maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ bla brang nyi lde na bzhugs pa'i rigs ldan chen po'i sku gdung gi lo rgyus kyi yi ge/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
